title: CSRF middleware enforced on mutating routes only
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag skipping GET/HEAD/OPTIONS as a hole, or the length check as a timing leak. Safe methods are skipped because they must be side-effect free by HTTP semantics (the handlers behind them honour that contract), while every mutating request must present the session token; the comparison itself runs through timingSafeEqual, whose equal-length precondition is checked first and leaks only length; a missing session token fails closed with 403 rather than passing.
